newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open flat to $5 higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open flat to $5 higher.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open unchanged to $5 higher Thursday in line with gains overnight in London, traders said.

LIFFE cocoa retreated to flat to firmer levels at Thursday's midsession after an early attempt to trigger technical buy stops was unsuccessful. September was up three stg at the break at 1,140 stg a tonne, in the middle of its 1,145 to 1,135 stg range.

Wednesday, New York cocoa futures ended broadly lower on the heels of the market's run-up to nine-year highs. September settled down $29 at $1,683 a tonne after ranging from $1,698 to $1,675. Spot July ended down the same at $1,651, while the back months closed down $20 to $26.
Technically, traders pegged September resistance at $1,698 to $1,700. Near-term support was seen at Wednesday's low of $1,675, followed by $1,660 and then $1,654.
